context: Tests whether the agent writes a first-person narrative standup with an interesting opening and outcomes over activities, instead of echoing the bullets.

checklist.name: First person
checklist.description: The standup is written in first person (I, my).

checklist.name: Prose paragraphs
checklist.description: The output is narrative paragraphs with no bullet points or numbered lists.

checklist.name: Opening is not chronological
checklist.description: The first sentence does not start with 'Started the day', 'Yesterday I', or another flat chronological statement, and is not throat-clearing.

checklist.name: Outcomes over activities
checklist.description: The text leads with results such as the retry backoff fix shipped to production and CI going green, rather than listing meetings and tasks.

checklist.name: Keeps specifics
checklist.description: Concrete details survive: payments-api, the shared Postgres fixture, 28 of 31 Sentry errors, Dana and the Friday CSV deadline, Omar and the Kafka consumer lag dashboard.

checklist.name: No emoji or filler
checklist.description: No emoji, no greeting, and no closers like 'let me know if you have questions'.
